title: Hearing-Aid Charge and Wear Routine
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eldercare:activity device=hearing_aid
| stats sum(eval(if(status="worn",1,0))) as wear_events, sum(eval(if(status="charged",1,0))) as charge_events by resident
| eval charge_to_wear_ratio=round(charge_events/wear_events,2)
| sort - charge_to_wear_ratio
description: Compares hearing-aid wear events with charging events to find routine gaps that may affect usability.
value: Assistive devices only help when they are charged, worn, and available at the right times.
implementation: Log hearing-aid charge and wear activity in `eldercare:activity`; compare both counts per resident.
visualization: Table of residents with hearing-aid charge-to-wear ratio.
grandmaExplanation: It logs whether hearing aids are getting charged and worn consistently enough to stay useful.
